title: Cylinder
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees in all axes and a translation vector also set to zero. On this coordinate system, create a new face and within this face, draw a single loop. In this loop, draw a circle with its center at coordinates [0.0394, 0.0394] and a radius of 0.0394 units. After drawing the circle, apply a scale factor of 0.0788 to the entire sketch to adjust the size of the circle. Since the Euler angles and translation vector are already set to zero, no further transformation is required. Next, extrude the scaled 2D sketch along the normal direction by 0.75 units to create a solid cylindrical body. The resulting dimensions of the cylinder are: length of 0.07875000000000001 units, width of 0.07875000000000001 units, and height of 0.75 units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch for the base of the cylinder
sketch = (
    workplane
    .center(0.0394, 0.0394)  # Move to the center of the circle
    .circle(0.0394)  # Draw a circle with the given radius
)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = cylinder
